name: VMware Cloud on AWS
description: Atomic CRUD workflows for the VMware Cloud on AWS API, one per curated operation in vmware_cloud_on_aws-latest.json.

document.name: Get Organizations
document.description: Get organizations associated with calling user

0001.name: GetOrganizations
0001.description: Get organizations associated with calling user

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Array of organizations. is at response.body.

document.name: Get Organization
document.description: Get details of an organization.

0001.name: GetOrganization
0001.description: Get details of an organization.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Organization details. is at response.body.

document.name: List SDDCs
document.description: List all the SDDCs of an organization.

0001.name: ListSDDCs
0001.description: List all the SDDCs of an organization.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Array of SDDCs. is at response.body.

document.name: Create SDDC
document.description: Provision a new SDDC.

0001.name: CreateSDDC
0001.description: Provision a new SDDC.

num_hosts.description: Number of hosts for the initial cluster.

host_instance_type.description: AWS instance type for hosts, e.g. i3.metal, r5.metal, i3en.metal.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Task tracking the SDDC provisioning. is at response.body.

document.name: Get SDDC
document.description: Get details of an SDDC.

0001.name: GetSDDC
0001.description: Get details of an SDDC.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). SDDC details. is at response.body.

document.name: Rename SDDC
document.description: Change the name of an SDDC.

0001.name: RenameSDDC
0001.description: Change the name of an SDDC.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Updated SDDC. is at response.body.

document.name: Delete SDDC
document.description: Delete an SDDC.

0001.name: DeleteSDDC
0001.description: Delete an SDDC.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Task tracking the SDDC deletion. is at response.body.

document.name: Create Cluster
document.description: Add a cluster to an SDDC.

0001.name: CreateCluster
0001.description: Add a cluster to an SDDC.

num_hosts.description: Number of hosts for the new cluster.

host_instance_type.description: AWS instance type, e.g. i3.metal, r5.metal, i3en.metal.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Task tracking the cluster creation. is at response.body.

document.name: Delete Cluster
document.description: Delete a cluster from an SDDC.

0001.name: DeleteCluster
0001.description: Delete a cluster from an SDDC.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Task tracking the cluster deletion. is at response.body.

document.name: Reconfigure Cluster
document.description: Initiate a reconfiguration for a cluster.

0001.name: ReconfigureCluster
0001.description: Initiate a reconfiguration for a cluster.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Task tracking the cluster reconfiguration. is at response.body.

document.name: Add Or Remove Hosts
document.description: Add or remove one or more ESX hosts in the target SDDC.

0001.name: AddOrRemoveHosts
0001.description: Add or remove one or more ESX hosts in the target SDDC.

num_hosts.description: Number of hosts to add or remove.

esxs.description: ESX host IDs to remove (required when action=remove).

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Task tracking the host add/remove operation. is at response.body.

document.name: List Public IPs
document.description: List all public IPs allocated to an SDDC.

0001.name: ListPublicIPs
0001.description: List all public IPs allocated to an SDDC.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Array of public IPs. is at response.body.

document.name: Allocate Public IP
document.description: Allocate one or more public IPs for an SDDC.

0001.name: AllocatePublicIP
0001.description: Allocate one or more public IPs for an SDDC.

count.description: Number of public IPs to allocate.

names.description: Names for the workload VM public IP assignments.

private_ips.description: Workload VM private IPs to associate with the allocated public IPs.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Task tracking the public IP allocation. is at response.body.

document.name: Get Public IP
document.description: Get one public IP allocated to an SDDC.

0001.name: GetPublicIP
0001.description: Get one public IP allocated to an SDDC.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Public IP details. is at response.body.

document.name: Update Public IP
document.description: Attach or detach a public IP to a workload VM.

0001.name: UpdatePublicIP
0001.description: Attach or detach a public IP to a workload VM.

private_ip.description: Private IP of the workload VM to attach this public IP to (omit to detach).

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Updated public IP. is at response.body.

document.name: Delete Public IP
document.description: Free one public IP allocated to an SDDC.

0001.name: DeletePublicIP
0001.description: Free one public IP allocated to an SDDC.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Confirmation that the public IP was freed. is at response.body.

0001.description: Get the logical networks (segments) defined in an SDDC.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Array of logical networks. is at response.body.

document.name: Create Network
document.description: Create a logical network (segment) in an SDDC.

0001.name: CreateNetwork
0001.description: Create a logical network (segment) in an SDDC.

cgwId.description: Compute gateway (edge) ID the network is attached to.

subnets.description: Gateway address and prefix length for the network.

dhcpConfigs.description: DHCP pool configuration for the network.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Confirmation that the logical network was created. is at response.body.

document.name: Get Network
document.description: Get a logical network (segment) by ID.

0001.name: GetNetwork
0001.description: Get a logical network (segment) by ID.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Logical network details. is at response.body.

document.name: Update Network
document.description: Update a logical network (segment).

0001.name: UpdateNetwork
0001.description: Update a logical network (segment).

cgwId.description: Compute gateway (edge) ID the network is attached to.

subnets.description: Gateway address and prefix length for the network.

dhcpConfigs.description: DHCP pool configuration for the network.

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Confirmation that the logical network was updated. is at response.body.

document.name: Delete Network
document.description: Delete a logical network (segment).

0001.name: DeleteNetwork
0001.description: Delete a logical network (segment).

response.description: Full HTTP response envelope ({ok, url, status, headers, text, body}). Confirmation that the logical network was deleted. is at response.body.
